scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "npm run test:watch --workspace frontend" "npm run test:watch --workspace backend"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace frontend && npm run test:coverage --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
